desc: Derive the recurrence for whether position `x` is reachable based on reachable positions in `[x-B, x-A]`.
Design a compact state representation of the most recent `B` reachability values, accounting for bad positions.
Implement and validate interval processing using Boolean-matrix powers for safe runs and explicit zero transitions for bad intervals.
Analyze edge cases: no bad intervals, gaps shorter than `A`, inaccessible positions after a bad block, and reaching exactly `N`.
